description: Correction to Gazette Ex. No. 2194/57 of 24.09.2020 (Corrected as 2020.11.09 (Inquiry) and 2020.11.02 respectively)
categorisation: This gazette content is a correction notice related to land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically deals with the acquisition of a servitude (a right over land) and provides revised dates for interested persons to appear and submit claims for compensation. The content falls squarely within land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
